rerank_expected_basis: per-needle gate_kept: 18 of 18 needles were rerank-eligible (gate_kept not null and not 0), + 1 untimed warmup query
note: daemon_log_posts_* are counted from THIS run's own daemon log (a fresh daemon and a fresh log per run, so counts never accumulate across runs). daemon_log_posts_rerank is a RUN TOTAL spanning BOTH arms, not an ON-arm count — it is compared against the ON side's expectation because the OFF arm reranks nothing and therefore contributes zero. daemon_log_posts_total spans every POST /encode/* family, so a dense-leg fallback divergence between the two runs is visible even when the rerank floor holds. daemon_proof_ok also folds in the ladder's own arm_valid verdicts (see invalid_arms). Direction: multiply any paired (arm - baseline) delta by delta_sign to obtain (ON - OFF).
